title: Transforming the Language of Life: Transformer Neural Networks for Protein Prediction Tasks
summary: Conference paper: a small transformer pretrained on protein sequence representations, fine-tuned to state-of-the-art performance on protein family classification and interaction prediction. The first paper in the language-of-life line.
authors: Ananthan Nambiar; Maeve Heflin; Simon Liu; Sergei Maslov; Mark Hopkins; Anna M. Ritz
